mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as accommodative monetary policy reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 8.0% signals economic distress that weakens corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) coupled with a stagnant or declining policy rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an impending monetary policy response delay, increasing real interest rate uncertainty and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2% in 1 month AND FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (defined by housing starts above 550 thousand units and GDP growth above 11500 billion dollars), the S&P 500 is expected to decline over the next 20 days due to anticipated monetary tightening and profit-taking.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the late-cycle expansion condition, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) signals robust economic growth and rising corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 212.5 signals accelerating inflation that triggers expectations of monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 212.5, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply contraction regime (INDPRO below 95), manufacturing output declines, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a demand surge without corresponding supply capacity, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% in 1 month AND INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
